subject.title: [Bug]: WebChat can render assistant reply before user prompt and duplicate inbound messages

question: Should #95566 remain open as a combined WebChat ordering and duplicate-user tracker until #80670/#101494 or replacements land with end-to-end proof, or should maintainers split it into narrower canonical issues now?
rationale: Automation can identify the overlapping source boundaries and candidate PRs, but it cannot safely choose the durable chat.send contract or decide whether this broad report should close before end-to-end proof covers both symptoms.

options.title: Keep Combined Until Proof
options.body: Leave #95566 open under the umbrella and close it only after landed code proves visible order, durable history, and assembled context for the direct WebChat scenario.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Move the duplicate assistant symptom to #85771/#101494 and the durable user-turn symptom to #86946/#80670, then narrow or close #95566 only after that routing is explicit.

options.title: Close As Mitigated
options.body: Treat the current partial mitigations and open PRs as sufficient despite the lack of direct combined current-main proof.

recommendation.title: Keep Combined Until Proof
recommendation.body: Leave #95566 open under the umbrella and close it only after landed code proves visible order, durable history, and assembled context for the direct WebChat scenario.

likelyOwner.reason: The hardest remaining decision is the Gateway/session user-turn durability boundary, where the history trail is strongest.
